description: Use this when the person wants to check in about training or asks to record pain or swelling. Records their check-in. A morning milestone can post to their crew and notify crew members. Do not use to diagnose pain, when symptoms were mentioned only to ask for advice, or to log their weight.

idempotencyKey.description: A new random id for this change (a UUID). Send the same one again only to retry this exact change.

note.description: Anything else they said, in their words.

readiness.description: How they feel today: 1 Flat, 2 Meh, 3 Okay, 4 Good, 5 On fire.

sessionId.description: The session it's about, from get_today; null for a morning check-in.

symptoms.description: What they reported; null for anything they didn't say.

after.description: Straight after the session: clear, or worse than before it.

behind.description: What they say is behind how they feel this morning.

effort.description: Effort for the whole session, 1 to 10.

feel.description: How the session felt: rough, fine or great.

knee.description: Swelling anywhere: clear, ache or swollen.

more.description: Sets they could have added: none, one or two.

morning.description: true for a morning check-in, which has no session.

next.description: The morning after the session: clear or worse.

pec.description: Pain anywhere: clear, sore, or sharp (sharp pain or pulling).

soreness.description: The kind of soreness: muscle, joint, sharp or swelling.

strength.description: How strong they felt: flat, normal or strong.

name: record_checkin
title: Check in
